title: S.I. No. 9 of 2026 - Fiscal Incentives (Plastic Solution Limited) Order
text:
91
Fiscal Incentives (Plastic Solution Limited) Order
SAINT LUCIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT, 2026, No. 9
[ 26th January, 2026 ]
In exercise of the powers conferred under sections 5, 6, and 12
of the Fiscal Incentives Act, Cap. 15.16, Cabinet makes this Order:
Citation
1. This Order may be cited as the Fiscal Incentives (Plastic
Solution Limited) Order, 2026.
Approved enterprise
2. Plastic Solution Limited is declared an approved enterprise.
Approved services
3. Plastic film, plastic sheets and assorted plastic bags, including
plastic packaging for manufactured goods, garment bags, freezer bags,
garbage bags, coin bags, fresh food bags, dry food bags, bakery bags,
and shopping bags are declared to be the approved products of Plastic
Solution Limited.
Declared benefit with regard to income tax
4. Subject to section 6, the declared benefit with regard to income
tax is a one hundred per cent waiver of income tax for a period of five
years commencing from the 1st day of November, 2025 and terminating
on the 31st day of October, 2030.
Declared benefit with regard to import duty
5.—(1) Subject to subsection (2) and section 6, the declared benefit
with regard to import duty is a one hundred per cent waiver of import
duty on the importation of —
(a) equipment and material inputs for equipment to be used
in the manufacture of the approved products; and
(b) one recycle truck and one delivery van, whether imported
or purchased locally.

Fiscal Incentives (Plastic Solution Limited) Order
(2) The declared benefit under subsection (1) is applicable for a
period of five years commencing from the 1st day of November, 2025
and terminating on the 31st day of October, 2030.
Conditions
6. The declared benefits under sections 4 and 5 are subject to the
conditions that—
(a) in the case of section 5(1)(b), the signage of Plastic
Solution Limited is displayed prominently on the recycle
truck and the delivery van;
(b) the particulars of the recycle truck and delivery van are
approved by the Ministry of Commerce;
(c) Plastic Solution Limited complies with —
(i) the statutory or regulatory requirements, including the
provision of statistical information to the Ministry of
Commerce,
(ii) the monitoring requirements of the Ministry of
Commerce or other authorized agency of the
Government.
Made this 21st day of January, 2026.
AGOSTA DEGAZON,
Cabinet Secretary.
